data.sub: Jay Shah lagataar doosri baar bane ICC Chairman

chat.say: Bhai script writer ab duniya chalayega!
Chunav ki zaroorat hi nahi padi boss!

data.asar: Cricket ab sidha Olympics tak dhoom machayega!
data.caption:
Jay Shah firse ban gaye hain ICC ke Chairman, wo bhi lagataar doosri baar bina kisi virodh ke! 🇮🇳🏏

• Lagataar 2nd time nirvirodh chune gaye ICC ke boss 🏆
• 2028 Olympics mein cricket par rahega poora focus 🥇
• Cricket ke global vistar ki ban rahi hai poori planning 🌍

Script itni tight hai ki saamne koi khada hi nahi hua! 😂

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo har match mein ICC ki script dhoondhta hai! 👇
